explanatory_boundary: These passages supply the original-paper parent context: the three-cusp divisor C, the log-canonical pullback isomorphism for the reduced inverse-image divisor E, additive heights, invariance of height BD-classes under line-bundle isomorphism, and the resulting height decomposition in the proof of Theorem 2.1. The exact auxiliary identity canonical+cusp = polar(phi)+div(r), with an explicit rational-function witness r, is a statement to be proved in the formal Genl/Heights/Belyi source; it is not quoted verbatim from this paper. Likewise, a uniform bound for arbitrary explicit polar presentations from a principal relation requires the precise quantifiers, presentation data, and constants established by the formal source. The paper states the parent relation using line bundles and BD-classes; it does not state those two auxiliary lemmas in their explicit presentation-level form.
